body:
PR-2864 at 46e134be96 (Refs STORY-1843; STRICT review per signoff).
- aca8ca0d handle at session start: agent_handle.rs (vendor-role-NN; common-root lock and reservation; UUID bound to the native session; name bounds; reserved aliases), wired into the SessionStart touch, agent new (preview reserves nothing), --bg adoption and agent register. Tests: 7 in agent_handle.rs, including a concurrency test.
- aceb5213 statusline handle for claude/agy (payload session id) and codex (thread-id env). Tests: statusline_session_evidence_covers_all_three_clients, current_session_handle_matches_by_session_never_borrows_another.
- ac97b025 agent ls HANDLE column; cross-vendor test; dead rows marked. Sandboxed liveness is BUG-2212's PR-2860, independent of this PR.
- acfeb946 mail by handle reaches the holder's notice; unknown handle refused, no phantom inbox. Tests: mail_to_a_handle_reaches_the_session_holding_it_and_nothing_else, plus anchored resolver refusal tests.
- C3 write mode recorded as post-deployment criterion acf32e9f.
- Remaining: ac0eef56 (PR3, after TASK-2253) and C2 relay (PR4).
Gates: targeted runs 406 and 130 passed (the only failure was a sandbox HOME test unrelated to this change); check-ci-fast 34 passed at both commits.
subject: READY: PR-2864 (STORY-1843 PR2b)
